strengths: Owner price, currency, source HTML, encoded CTA and frozen output identify the same advertised offer.
Product quantity claims distinguish app recipes from PDF content, with numerical examples visibly qualified.

limitations: No human listening capability was available. I cannot certify naturalness, intelligibility or complete removal of source music; the separation record explicitly preserves that uncertainty. This limits approval to financial accuracy, traceability and the inspected production evidence rather than auditory acceptance.
I did not watch continuous video, independently repeat browser checks, verify all manifest entries, test checkout or verify store/admin price configuration.
Asset provenance is recorded project evidence, not independent legal clearance. I did not inspect other experts' verdicts or certify the aggregate fifty-agent process.
